products.title: Triple Shine Garden edition

variants.description:
TRIPLE-THREAT FORMULATION: Made with three key ingredients for glowing skin: Belight®, niacin (vitamin B3), and vitamin C. 

REAL RESULTS: One powerful formula targets three main concerns to help your skin look brighter, clearer, and more refined. 

BASED IN SCIENCE: Formulated to work with the natural processes of your body for maximum impact with minimal ingredients. 

NOTHING ARTIFICIAL: Flavored with organic grape concentrate sourced from the French regions of Bordeaux and Champagne. Naturally sweet and sugar- gluten- and dairy-free. 

ENJOY DAILY: No messy powders or water here. Just sip and enjoy wherever and whenever you like.
